title: A developer logs the visitor's IP address each time a customer record is viewed. Expected: blocked under the rule against personal data in logs.
diff:
--- a/api/v2/customers.py
+++ b/api/v2/customers.py
@@ -11,3 +11,4 @@
 def get_customer(customer_id: int, request: Request, user=Depends(require_user)):
     customer = customers.get(customer_id)
+    logger.info("Customer %s viewed from %s", customer_id, request.client.host)
     return customer
